reviews.text: Nico's crew was on our roof at 5:45 in the morning, done before it hit 100. Old package unit out by crane, new one set, and the curb sealed so the ceiling stays dry in monsoon.
reviews.name: Teresa V.

reviews.text: After the haboob the unit was running but the air was barely cool. The coil was caked brown. They washed it out and the supply air dropped almost 15 degrees.
reviews.name: Omar F.

reviews.text: I rent out two houses in Chandler. They tested both against the 82 degree rule, wrote down the numbers, and flagged a duct that was pulling attic air. Tenants stopped calling me.
reviews.name: Linda H.

reviews.text: Lightning took out something on our AC in August. They checked the contactor, capacitor and the surge protector, replaced two parts, and walked me through why the breaker kept tripping.
reviews.name: Ben W.

reviews.text: Our Arizona room was useless in summer. The ductless unit went in on a Tuesday and now it's where we eat dinner. Lines are covered neatly along the stucco.
reviews.name: Carmen L.

reviews.text: The day they came was the hottest of the week and the earliest slot was already gone, so we waited until the next morning. Once here, fast and tidy, and the price matched the text.
reviews.name: Hugh D.

prices.note: credited if you go ahead with the repair
